{07 00 00}You know {01 00 00 05 00}that I'm known as
the hide-and-seek master
of {04 03 00}, {07 0b 00}right?
{07 14 00}Right, {01 00 00 05 00}so as a part of my
training, I want you to play
hide-and-seek with me!
If you beat me, which is
really unlikely, I'll give you
something, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
